parts:
Hi Scott,

You have an extraneous backslash before the command. Instead of "\bin\stansummary.exe" it should be "bin\stansummary.exe"

For future reference, mind just pasting the image into the email or on Google groups? I think it still allows images. Just having an extra step of finding something to open a docx is inconvenient. 


Daniel
